description:
We are VZD TerraTech, an innovative development team building VZD (MARS//GUIDE) — a comprehensive, offline-first Martian navigation and exploration guide designed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. 

Our project features real-time NASA Mars Trek MOLA mapping, a Sci-Fi tactical user interface and seamless bilingual support (Arabic & English). 

We are looking for passionate developers, designers, and space enthusiasts who want to build cutting-edge space exploration tools!
summary: VZD TerraTech presents MARS//GUIDE, an advanced, interactive cross-platform mobile exploration system designed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our application provides real-time Martian tactical navigation, authentic MOLA topographic mapping, and immersive audio-visual telemetry. By leveraging open NASA planetary datasets, PDS archives, and high-resolution spatial models, MARS//GUIDE empowers researchers, students, and space enthusiasts to explore Martian landmarks (such as Olympus Mons and Jezero Crater), analyze atmospheric conditions, and calculate optimal rover paths through a futuristic Sci-Fi tactical HUD interface. The project bridges complex planetary science with accessible mobile technology, inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
details: What it does & how it works: MARS//GUIDE functions as an all-in-one tactical command station for Mars exploration. It integrates OSMDroid with official NASA MOLA Colorized Elevation tile services to render true 3D topographical relief maps of Mars, complete with crater rims, canyon systems, and elevation gradients. It features a cinematic boot sequence utilizing historic Apollo 11 archives, combined with an authentic NASA audio engine featuring over 12 real mission sound effects (including Perseverance Martian wind and SuperCam laser recordings). Benefits & Intended Impact: The app democratizes planetary science data, allowing users to interact with high-fidelity geographical and meteorological data of Mars in real-time, boosting engagement with space exploration and climate/geological studies. Tools, Languages & Technologies: Developed using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Python, OSMDroid, ExoPlayer (Media3), Coil, Room Database, and Material3, structured within a clean MVVM architecture.
dataRefs: NASA PDS MOLA Elevation Datasets & Mars 2020 Perseverance Archives
